meta.owner: e (data & copy) - content ready, wiring owned by ATLAS
meta.purpose: Between-sector event cards: one card is drawn after each debrief (sectors 1 and 2 only). The player picks one of two options; the choice applies to the next sector.
meta.selection: Deterministic per run: index = (run.seed + sector * 17) % count, skipping any event id already used this run. No event after sector 3.
meta.effect_notes: All *_next effects are banked in run.pending and applied at the start of the next begin_sector(). budget_delta and approval_delta apply immediately. See docs/EVENTS.md for the exact clamps and insertion points.

events.title: SOLAR STORM
events.body: A coronal mass ejection crosses the cruise. The bus can ride it out behind a thin shield, or go dark and lose the window.

choices.label: SAFE MODE
choices.detail: -3 sols next sector, no extra heat.

events.title: PRIVATE DONOR
events.body: A billionaire offers a no-strings grant. The review board reads the announcement as a conflict of interest.

events.title: SALVAGE WRECK
events.body: A derelict survey craft drifts on the same transfer. Its tanks are intact; its harness is not.

choices.label: DRAIN THE TANKS
choices.detail: +20% delta-v next sector, -1 integrity next sector.

events.title: WINDOW SLIP
events.body: Launch integration slips. The agency can hold the date and rush the closeout, or take the later window and lose surface time.

choices.label: KEEP THE DATE
choices.detail: +4 sols next sector, -2 integrity next sector.

choices.label: SLIP THE WINDOW
choices.detail: -2 sols next sector, +2 integrity next sector.

events.title: PEER REVIEW
events.body: The science board will either fast-track your results or bury them in review. Both cost the agency something.

events.title: CONTRACTOR AUDIT
events.body: A supplier audit finds a cracked harness. Fix it properly, or take the rebate and fly with it.

events.title: RIVAL LEAK
events.body: A rival agency leaks your route to the press. The agency can lean into the attention or stay quiet.

events.title: GRAVITY ASSIST
events.body: A gas giant lines up for a free trajectory change - if the bus can take the burn.

choices.label: TAKE THE SLING
choices.detail: +1 move range next sector, -12% delta-v next sector.
